effect.gastronomicon.gluttons_feast.forb: §cThe Glutton's Desire Is Not Yet Satisfied...
advancements.gastronomicon.first_bite.de: You opened the first page of Gastronomicon
tooltip.gastronomicon.dragon_breath_conf: §aDragon breath exploding on the tongue; one burp could ignite a village.
tooltip.gastronomicon.void_core.desc: §5Eating it makes you feel like only a thin layer of reality separates you from the Void.
tooltip.gastronomicon.ancient_heartbroth: §cA bowl of scalding magma soup; you'll feel like a walking furnace afterwards.
tooltip.gastronomicon.sculk_resonant_fun: §bIt whispers in your stomach, letting you hear secrets from the other side of the wall.
tooltip.gastronomicon.wardens_oculus.des: §8When you gaze into the abyss, the abyss gazes also into your dinner plate.
tooltip.gastronomicon.philosophers_toffe: §6Every bite tastes like knowledge, though the side effect is becoming a bit 'cold-blooded'.
tooltip.gastronomicon.chronos_cake.desc: §dTime tied itself in a knot here; death is just a small interlude back to the start.
tooltip.gastronomicon.prismarine_power_c: §bThe taste of the sea has never been so intense; land feels a bit 'heavy' now.
tooltip.gastronomicon.blighted_golden_ap: §4Golden skin can't hide the scent of decay; a near-death carnival is about to begin.
tooltip.gastronomicon.gluttons_feast.des: §lThe will of Gluttony manifests here; save for this feast, there is no delicacy in the world.
